module: Flowgraph node "Set UI Race Recovery" (category repeat_instant, author BeamNG, duration): updates the recovery counter UI app (vehicle reset). Inputs: "cur" (number or string), "max". Text sent via 'RaceRecoveryCounterSet' (e.g. "Recoveries Used: 2 / 5"); reset with 'RaceRecoveryCounterReset'.
notes: The text "Recoveries Used" is hardcoded (not translated).

work.desc: Sends the counter if cur and the input flow are active, otherwise resets.
